transcript: Place a bay leaf under your pillow and it will give you clarity in dreams and ward off insomnia and nightmares. Bay leaves aren't just a cooking spice, they're one of the most powerful plants from ancient traditions. In our monastery we use them in seven different ways. First, under the pillow, it brings lucid dreams and keeps nightmares away. Your mind cleanses while you sleep. Second, behind your phone, it attracts positive news and calls that change your path. Third, boil it and spray the water around your house. It eliminates arguments and brings peace to every corner. Fourth, write your wish on a leaf and burn it with intention. The smoke carries your request where it needs to go. Fifth, always carry a leaf in your bag. It's a shield against gossip and envy that tries to block your path. Sixth, put a leaf in your left shoe before an interview or important meeting. You'll walk with the confidence of someone who already knows they're going to succeed. Seventh, mix bay leaves with rice in an open jar in your kitchen. You'll never lack food or abundance on your table. Bay leaf is the plant of victory. It's been used for centuries to protect, attract and open paths. Always use it with intention. Write in the comments which of these rituals you already knew and which one you're going to try first. But I want you to understand something. Bay leaves move energy from outside. But if fear, stress and a scarcity mindset still live inside you, what the bay leaf attracts has nowhere to stay. Rituals open doors, but what keeps them open is what happens inside you. And if you want to build that inner peace where all good things remain, I've spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do it. And everything I know is inside the path back to calm. The link is in my profile.
